record.issue_text: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:27 — The referer host must exactly match embeddable_host, so `www.` subdomains, ports, and https/http variants fail, and the embed_url host is never checked against embeddable_host in the controller. Neither case is covered by specs. (P2, conf 50)

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, access is gated by an exact host equality check: `URI(request.referer || '').host != SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, so a `www.` variant (or any other subdomain) will be rejected unless the setting matches exactly. Also, the controller does not validate `params[:embed_url]` against `embeddable_host` before enqueuing `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` (the host validation happens later in `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`), which can lead to pointless enqueues/rendering `loading` for mismatched `embed_url`. The controller specs only cover missing host, missing referer, and happy-path, and do not cover these edge cases. (Note: the finding’s claim about ports and http/https variants failing is not supported here because `.host` ignores scheme and port.)
